Name: Grandpa's Ghost Chinese
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/cdb808f8-3f90-4c80-a5ea-8015defaf196.png[/img][size=4]Leaves rustle outside, dancing and twirling around your feet as you open your front door. You can barely make out the lingering scents of cinnamon and vanilla and pie crust wafting from the kitchen. The farmhouse settles around you with creaks and the rattling of that pesky sideboard you've been meaning to nail down, and the soft susurration of tree branches brushing against the house remind you that only a few days of Fall remain. So much to do to ready the farm for Winter. Another season, almost over. But wait...what was that sound?

﻿It's the week before Spirit's Eve, a time when the veil between the worlds is thin, granting spirits more power and ability to affect the physical plane.[/size][size=4]
[i]Do you believe in ghosts?
[/i][/size]
